curriculumAndResearch.sourceCorrection: The prior Kang Hsuan evidence URL was a public plan whose retrieved content was not the claimed English curriculum plan. It was replaced with Zhongxiao Junior High's actual 112 school-year English plan. Repeated generic claims about phoneme/syllable patterns were replaced with source-specific observations and explicit evidence limits.
curriculumAndResearch.fusionLimit: Nani/Kang Hsuan/Hanlin assigned chapter texts were not obtained. This is an original curriculum-grounded synthesis informed by three public school version-identification plans and a Hanlin supplement description, not a claim of complete chapter-by-chapter textbook comparison.
